## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("linestring_shapefile_baseline")

    data = geocase_case.load()
```

## What this case checks

Provide a canonical linestring encoded as a Shapefile so format-specific loader behavior can be compared directly against the GeoJSON baseline.

## Risk types covered

- [`format_comparison`](../risk/format-comparison.md)
